title: Whisper & Speech AI
description: Whisper (OpenAI): Robust speech recognition. Mel-spectrogram, encoder-decoder Transformer, multilingual (99 languages). ASR, speech translation, language identification. Production-grade accuracy.

content.level0_basic: Speech AI: Ses → metin dönüşümü (Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR). Whisper (OpenAI, 2022): State-of-the-art ASR model. 680K saat audio data, 99 dil, robust (gürültü, aksanlar). Architecture: Encoder-decoder Transformer. Input: Audio waveform → Mel-spectrogram (80 channels, log-scale). Encoder: Audio features → context representation. Decoder: Autoregressive text generation. Multitask: (1) Transcription (aynı dilde), (2) Translation (İngilizce'ye), (3) Language ID. Zero-shot: Eğitilmediği aksan/domain'lerde bile çalışır. OpenAI API, local (transformers library).
content.level1_beginner: Whisper modelleri: (1) **tiny** (39M params, 32x realtime, mobile-friendly). (2) **base** (74M, 16x realtime). (3) **small** (244M, 6x realtime, balanced). (4) **medium** (769M, 2x realtime, high accuracy). (5) **large-v3** (1.55B, 1x realtime, SOTA). Trade-off: Speed vs accuracy. Audio preprocessing: (1) Resample 16kHz (model requirement). (2) 30-second chunks (context window). (3) Mel-spectrogram (80 bins, log-scale frequency). (4) Normalization. Decoder: (1) Prompt tokens (task, language). (2) Timestamp tokens (word-level timing). (3) Special tokens (<|startoftranscript|>, <|en|>, <|notimestamps|>). (4) Beam search / sampling. Multilingual: 99 languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic, Turkish...). Language auto-detection. Translation: Any language → English (single model).
content.level2_application: Pratik kullanım: (1) **Python API**: `pip install openai-whisper`, `whisper audio.mp3 --model medium --language tr`. (2) **Transformers**: Hugging Face pipeline, `pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model='openai/whisper-large-v3')`. (3) **OpenAI API**: Cloud-based, pay-per-minute. (4) **Fine-tuning**: Custom domain (medical, legal), low-resource languages. Use cases: (1) **Transcription**: Podcast, meetings, lectures. (2) **Subtitles**: Video captions, accessibility. (3) **Voice assistants**: Siri, Alexa alternatives. (4) **Translation**: Multilingual customer support. (5) **Medical**: Doctor-patient conversation transcription. (6) **Legal**: Court proceedings. Performance: (1) WER (Word Error Rate): 5-10% (clean audio), 15-25% (noisy). (2) Real-time factor: large-v3 ~1x (30-sec audio in 30 sec). (3) Robustness: Accents, background noise, music. Limitations: (1) Hallucination (silence → random text). (2) 30-sec context (long-form needs chunking). (3) Proper names (hallucination risk). (4) Code-switching (mixed languages).
content.level3_advanced: Architecture details: (1) **Mel-Spectrogram**: Audio → STFT (Short-Time Fourier Transform) → Mel-scale (human perception). 80 Mel bins, 25ms window, 10ms hop. Log-scale (dB). (2) **Encoder**: Transformer (6-32 layers). Conv1D stem (2 layers, stride 2 → 2x downsample). Sinusoidal positional encoding. Self-attention (audio features). Output: Audio context (1500 frames → 750 tokens). (3) **Decoder**: Transformer (6-32 layers). Cross-attention (encoder output). Causal self-attention (autoregressive). Vocabulary: 51865 tokens (multilingual BPE). (4) **Training**: Weakly-supervised (internet audio + auto-generated transcripts). Multitask (transcription + translation + language ID). Loss: Cross-entropy. 680K hours (English 438K, multilingual 242K). Data augmentation: Speed perturbation, noise injection. (5) **Inference**: Prompt: `<|startoftranscript|><|tr|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>`. Beam search (width=5). Temperature sampling (fallback). VAD (Voice Activity Detection) for chunking. Timestamp tokens: <|0.00|>, <|0.02|> (20ms resolution).
content.level4_expert: Expert topics: (1) **Fine-tuning**: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) for memory efficiency. Dataset: Custom domain (legal, medical). WER improvement: 30% → 10% (domain-specific). (2) **Distillation**: large → small (student-teacher). OpenAI Distil-Whisper (6x faster, ~1% WER loss). (3) **Long-form**: >30sec audio. Chunking strategies: (a) Fixed 30s (overlap 5s). (b) VAD-based (silence detection). (c) Prompt conditioning (previous transcript as context). (4) **Hallucination**: Silence → repetitive/random text. Mitigation: (a) VAD preprocessing. (b) Logprob threshold. (c) Repetition penalty. (d) Prompt: 'No speech'. (5) **Timestamps**: Word-level alignment. CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) alternative. Forced alignment (Whisper + CTC). (6) **Multilingual**: Language ID head (99 classes). Low-resource languages (Turkish, Arabic). Code-switching (English + Spanish). (7) **Real-time**: Streaming (not native in Whisper). Workarounds: (a) Sliding window. (b) Faster-Whisper (CTranslate2, 4x speedup). (c) Whisper.cpp (C++ port, CPU-optimized). (8) **Comparison**: (a) Wav2Vec 2.0 (Facebook, self-supervised). (b) Conformer (Google, convolution + Transformer). (c) MMS (Meta Massively Multilingual Speech, 1000+ languages). Whisper: Best multilingual, robust, production-ready. Research directions: (1) Streaming Whisper. (2) Better hallucination handling. (3) Emotion recognition (prosody). (4) Speaker diarization (who spoke when).

whatIsIt: Whisper: OpenAI'nin speech recognition modeli (2022). Encoder-decoder Transformer. 680K saat audio (weakly supervised), 99 dil. Input: Mel-spectrogram (80 bins, log-scale). Encoder: Audio → context (self-attention). Decoder: Autoregressive text (cross-attention). Multitask: Transcription, translation (→ English), language ID. Model sizes: tiny (39M) → large-v3 (1.55B). Zero-shot robust (accents, noise, domains). WER 5-10% (clean), 15-25% (noisy). Open-source (MIT license), Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API.
whyNeeded: Speech AI critical çünkü: (1) **Accessibility**: Deaf/hard-of-hearing (subtitles). Hands-free interaction (voice assistants). (2) **Multilingual**: 99 languages (global reach). Low-resource language support (Turkish, Arabic). (3) **Robustness**: Whisper accents, noise, music'e robust. Traditional ASR'ler clean audio'da fail. (4) **Zero-shot**: Yeni domain/accent'te fine-tuning gereksiz. Out-of-the-box accuracy. (5) **Translation**: Any language → English (single model). Multilingual customer support. (6) **Production**: OpenAI API (cloud), local (transformers). Scalable, reliable. (7) **Cost**: Open-source (free local inference). API ($0.006/minute). Traditional ASR pahalı (Google, AWS). (8) **Use cases**: Healthcare (doctor notes), legal (court transcripts), education (lecture captions), media (podcast subtitles). (9) **Real-time**: large-v3 ~1x realtime (30s in 30s). Faster models (tiny/base) 16-32x realtime. (10) **Research**: Foundation model (transfer learning). Fine-tune custom domains.
realWorldAnalogy: Whisper'ı bir **profesyonel tercüman/stenograf**'a benzetebiliriz. **Senaryo**: Çok uluslu konferans (99 farklı dil, gürültü, aksanlar). **Geleneksel ASR (eski stenograf)**: (1) Sadece temiz, standart aksan (BBC İngilizce). (2) Gürültülü ortamda fail (background music → hata). (3) Tek dil (İngilizce), diğer diller için ayrı uzman. (4) Yeni domain (tıp terminolojisi) → yeniden eğitim gerekir. **Whisper (süper stenograf)**: (1) **Multilingual**: 99 dil konuşur. Konuşmacı İspanyolca'dan İngilizce'ye geçse bile takip eder. (2) **Robust**: Cafe'de, müzikli ortamda, telefon görüşmesinde (düşük kalite) bile hatasız yazar. (3) **Zero-shot**: Tıp konferansında olmamış olsa bile medical terms'i doğru yazar (weak supervision sayesinde internet'ten öğrenmiş). (4) **Translation**: Fransızca konuşma → otomatik İngilizce yazıya çevirir (tek model, ek çaba yok). **Mel-Spectrogram (kulak)**: Ses dalgalarını frekans bileşenlerine ayırır (human auditory system gibi). Alçak sesler (bass) ve yüksek sesler (treble) ayrı ayrı algılanır. **Encoder (dinleme)**: Audio context'i anlar ('bu cümle soru mu, durum bildirimi mi?'). **Decoder (yazma)**: Kelime kelime yazar (autoregressive), önceki kelimelere bakarak sonrakini tahmin eder. **Beam search**: 5 farklı alternatif yazar, en olası olanı seçer.

formulas: \text{Mel-Spectrogram}: \quad S_{mel}(t, m) = \log\left( \sum_{f} |\text{STFT}(t, f)|^2 \cdot H_m(f) \right) \quad \text{(H_m: Mel filterbank)}
\text{WER (Word Error Rate)}: \quad \text{WER} = \frac{S + D + I}{N} \times 100\% \quad \text{(S: substitutions, D: deletions, I: insertions, N: total words)}
\text{Beam Search}: \quad \text{score}(y_{1:t}) = \sum_{i=1}^t \log P(y_i | y_{<i}, h) \quad \text{(keep top-k candidates)}
\text{STFT (Short-Time Fourier Transform)}: \quad X(t, f) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x(n) \cdot w(n - t) \cdot e^{-j2\pi fn}

stepByStep: 1. **Audio Input**: Waveform (any sample rate, mono/stereo). Resample → 16kHz (model requirement). Chunking: 30-second segments (Whisper context window). Overlap 5s (for continuity).
2. **Preprocessing**: (a) Convert stereo → mono (average channels). (b) Normalize amplitude ([-1, 1] range). (c) Pad/trim to 30 seconds (480,000 samples at 16kHz).

3. **Mel-Spectrogram**: STFT (Short-Time Fourier Transform). Window: 25ms (400 samples), hop: 10ms (160 samples). FFT size: 512. Result: Time-frequency matrix (3000 frames × 257 freq bins). Mel filterbank: 80 triangular filters (Hz → Mel scale). Log-scale (dB): log(magnitude). Output: 3000×80 (80 Mel bins over time).

4. **Encoder Input**: Mel-spectrogram (3000×80). Conv1D stem: 2 layers (kernel=3, stride=2). Downsample 2x → 1500 frames. Positional encoding (sinusoidal). Shape: [1500, d_model] (d_model=512-1280, model size'a göre).

5. **Encoder**: Transformer blocks (6-32 layers). Self-attention (audio features). Feedforward (MLP). LayerNorm, residual connections. Output: Audio context h (shape: [1500, d_model]). Represents acoustic features (phonetics, prosody, background).

6. **Decoder Prompt**: Special tokens (task, language, timestamps). Example: <|startoftranscript|><|tr|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>. Prompt length: 3-6 tokens. Conditioning decoder (what task to perform).

7. **Decoder (autoregressive)**: Generate tokens one by one. Cross-attention (encoder output h). Causal self-attention (previous tokens). Vocabulary: 51865 tokens (multilingual BPE). Logits → softmax → probability distribution. Sample/beam search (top token).
8. **Beam Search**: Keep top-k candidates (k=5 typical). Score = sum of log-probabilities. At each step: Expand each candidate, prune to top-k. Terminate: <|endoftext|> or max_length (448 tokens).

9. **Post-processing**: (a) Remove special tokens. (b) Decode BPE → text. (c) Timestamp alignment (if enabled). (d) Language detection (if auto). (e) Confidence scores (logprobs). (f) Hallucination filtering (repetition penalty).
10. **Output**: Transcription text (string). Optional: Word-level timestamps [(word, start, end), ...]. Language detected (if auto). Confidence score (average logprob).
algorithm.complexity: **Zaman**: Encoder: O(T²·D) (T=1500 frames, self-attention). Decoder: O(N·T·D) (N=output length, cross-attention). Total: ~1x realtime (large-v3), 4-16x (tiny/base). **Uzay**: Model: 39M-1.55B params. Mel-spectrogram: 3000×80 (0.96 MB). KV cache (inference): O(N·D·L) (L=layers). **Parallelization**: Encoder fully parallel (all frames). Decoder sequential (autoregressive). **Optimization**: (1) Flash Attention (memory efficient). (2) KV cache (avoid recomputation). (3) CTranslate2 (4x speedup, quantization). (4) Whisper.cpp (C++, CPU-optimized). (5) Batch inference (multiple audios parallel).

codeExamples.title: Whisper Basic Usage (openai-whisper)
codeExamples.code:
# pip install openai-whisper
import whisper
import numpy as np

# Load model (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3)
model = whisper.load_model('base')  # 74M params, 16x realtime

print(f'Model: {model.__class__.__name__}')
print(f'Dimensions: {model.dims}')
print(f'Languages: {len(model.is_multilingual)} supported\n')

# Load audio (mono, 16kHz recommended)
audio = whisper.load_audio('audio.mp3')
audio = whisper.pad_or_trim(audio)  # 30-second chunk

print(f'Audio shape: {audio.shape} ({len(audio)/16000:.1f} seconds at 16kHz)')

# Mel-spectrogram
mel = whisper.log_mel_spectrogram(audio).to(model.device)
print(f'Mel-spectrogram shape: {mel.shape}')  # (80, 3000)

# Detect language
_, probs = model.detect_language(mel)
lang = max(probs, key=probs.get)
print(f'\nDetected language: {lang} (prob: {probs[lang]:.2f})')

# Transcribe
options = whisper.DecodingOptions(language='tr', task='transcribe', fp16=False)
result = whisper.decode(model, mel, options)

print(f'\n=== Transcription ===')
print(result.text)
print(f'\nConfidence: {result.avg_logprob:.2f}')
print(f'No speech prob: {result.no_speech_prob:.3f}')

print('\nNote: For long audio, use whisper.transcribe() (auto-chunking)')
codeExamples.explanation: Whisper temel kullanım: load_model, audio preprocessing, Mel-spectrogram, language detection, decode. openai-whisper kütüphanesi.

codeExamples.title: Whisper Transformers (Hugging Face)
codeExamples.code:
# pip install transformers datasets[audio]
from transformers import WhisperProcessor, WhisperForConditionalGeneration
import torch
import librosa

# Load model and processor
model_name = 'openai/whisper-small'  # 244M params
processor = WhisperProcessor.from_pretrained(model_name)
model = WhisperForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(model_name)

print(f'Model: {model_name}')
print(f'Parameters: {model.num_parameters():,}')
print(f'Encoder layers: {model.config.encoder_layers}')
print(f'Decoder layers: {model.config.decoder_layers}\n')

# Load audio
audio, sr = librosa.load('audio.wav', sr=16000, mono=True)
print(f'Audio: {len(audio)/sr:.1f}s, sample rate: {sr} Hz')

# Process audio
input_features = processor(audio, sampling_rate=sr, return_tensors='pt').input_features
print(f'Input features shape: {input_features.shape}')  # (1, 80, 3000)

# Generate transcription (Turkish)
forced_decoder_ids = processor.get_decoder_prompt_ids(language='turkish', task='transcribe')
generated_ids = model.generate(input_features, forced_decoder_ids=forced_decoder_ids)

# Decode
transcription = processor.batch_decode(generated_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)[0]

print(f'\n=== Transcription ===')
print(transcription)

# Translation (Turkish → English)
print('\n=== Translation (Turkish → English) ===')
forced_decoder_ids_translate = processor.get_decoder_prompt_ids(language='turkish', task='translate')
generated_ids_translate = model.generate(input_features, forced_decoder_ids=forced_decoder_ids_translate)
translation = processor.batch_decode(generated_ids_translate, skip_special_tokens=True)[0]
print(translation)

print('\nTransformers: Easy integration, Hugging Face ecosystem')
codeExamples.explanation: Whisper Transformers: Hugging Face ecosystem. WhisperProcessor (audio preprocessing), WhisperForConditionalGeneration (model). Transcription + translation.

codeExamples.title: Mel-Spectrogram Visualization
codeExamples.code:
import numpy as np
import librosa
import librosa.display
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load audio
audio, sr = librosa.load('audio.wav', sr=16000, duration=5.0, mono=True)
print(f'Audio: {len(audio)} samples, {len(audio)/sr:.2f}s, {sr} Hz')

# Compute Mel-spectrogram
n_fft = 512  # FFT window size
hop_length = 160  # 10ms hop at 16kHz
n_mels = 80  # Whisper uses 80 Mel bins

mel_spec = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
    y=audio, 
    sr=sr, 
    n_fft=n_fft, 
    hop_length=hop_length, 
    n_mels=n_mels
)

# Log scale (dB)
mel_spec_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel_spec, ref=np.max)

print(f'\nMel-spectrogram shape: {mel_spec_db.shape}')  # (80, time_frames)
print(f'Time resolution: {hop_length/sr*1000:.1f} ms')
print(f'Frequency bins: {n_mels} (Mel scale)')

# Visualize
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8))

# Waveform
axes[0].plot(np.linspace(0, len(audio)/sr, len(audio)), audio)
axes[0].set_title('Audio Waveform')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Amplitude')
axes[0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# Mel-spectrogram
img = librosa.display.specshow(
    mel_spec_db, 
    x_axis='time', 
    y_axis='mel', 
    sr=sr, 
    hop_length=hop_length,
    ax=axes[1],
    cmap='viridis'
)
axes[1].set_title('Mel-Spectrogram (Log Scale)')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Mel Frequency')
fig.colorbar(img, ax=axes[1], format='%+2.0f dB')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print('\nMel-spectrogram: Time-frequency representation')
print('Mel scale: Human auditory perception (logarithmic)')
print('Whisper encoder input: 80 Mel bins × 3000 frames (30s audio)')
codeExamples.explanation: Mel-Spectrogram: Audio → STFT → Mel filterbank → log scale. 80 bins (Whisper), time-frequency representation. Human auditory perception.

codeExamples.title: Long-form Transcription (Chunking)
codeExamples.code:
import whisper
import numpy as np

# Load model
model = whisper.load_model('base')

# Long audio (> 30 seconds)
audio = whisper.load_audio('long_audio.mp3')  # e.g., 5 minutes
print(f'Audio length: {len(audio)/16000:.1f} seconds\n')

# Method 1: Built-in transcribe (auto-chunking)
print('=== Method 1: Built-in transcribe() ===')
result = model.transcribe(
    'long_audio.mp3',
    language='tr',
    task='transcribe',
    verbose=False
)

print(f'Text: {result["text"][:200]}...')  # First 200 chars
print(f'\nSegments: {len(result["segments"])}')
for seg in result['segments'][:3]:
    print(f'  [{seg["start"]:.1f}s - {seg["end"]:.1f}s]: {seg["text"]}')

# Method 2: Manual chunking (more control)
print('\n=== Method 2: Manual Chunking ===')
chunk_size = 30 * 16000  # 30 seconds
overlap = 5 * 16000  # 5 seconds overlap

transcripts = []
for i in range(0, len(audio), chunk_size - overlap):
    chunk = audio[i:i+chunk_size]
    chunk = whisper.pad_or_trim(chunk)
    
    mel = whisper.log_mel_spectrogram(chunk).to(model.device)
    options = whisper.DecodingOptions(language='tr', task='transcribe')
    result_chunk = whisper.decode(model, mel, options)
    
    transcripts.append(result_chunk.text)
    print(f'Chunk {i//chunk_size + 1}: {result_chunk.text[:50]}...')

full_transcript = ' '.join(transcripts)
print(f'\nFull transcript length: {len(full_transcript)} characters')

print('\nChunking strategies:')
print('1. Fixed 30s (overlap for continuity)')
print('2. VAD-based (silence detection)')
print('3. Prompt conditioning (previous chunk as context)')
codeExamples.explanation: Long-form transcription: >30s audio. Built-in transcribe() (auto-chunking) vs manual chunking (overlap, VAD). Whisper context window 30s.

codeExamples.title: Timestamp & Word-Level Alignment
codeExamples.code:
import whisper
import json

# Load model with word-level timestamps
model = whisper.load_model('base')

audio_file = 'audio.mp3'
print(f'Transcribing with timestamps: {audio_file}\n')

# Transcribe with word-level timestamps
result = model.transcribe(
    audio_file,
    language='tr',
    word_timestamps=True,  # Enable word-level timestamps
    verbose=False
)

print('=== Segment-Level Timestamps ===')
for seg in result['segments'][:3]:
    print(f'[{seg["start"]:.2f}s - {seg["end"]:.2f}s]: {seg["text"]}')
    
    # Word-level (if available)
    if 'words' in seg:
        print('  Words:')
        for word_info in seg['words'][:5]:  # First 5 words
            print(f'    {word_info["word"]}: {word_info["start"]:.2f}s - {word_info["end"]:.2f}s')

print('\n=== Full Transcript with Timecodes ===')
for seg in result['segments']:
    timestamp = f'[{seg["start"]//60:02.0f}:{seg["start"]%60:05.2f}]'
    print(f'{timestamp} {seg["text"]}')

# Export SRT subtitles
print('\n=== SRT Subtitles (Sample) ===')
for i, seg in enumerate(result['segments'][:3], 1):
    start = f'{int(seg["start"]//3600):02d}:{int((seg["start"]%3600)//60):02d}:{seg["start"]%60:06.3f}'.replace('.', ',')
    end = f'{int(seg["end"]//3600):02d}:{int((seg["end"]%3600)//60):02d}:{seg["end"]%60:06.3f}'.replace('.', ',')
    print(f'{i}\n{start} --> {end}\n{seg["text"]}\n')

print('Applications:')
print('- Subtitles (SRT, VTT format)')
print('- Video editing (align text with video)')
print('- Search (find exact timestamp of keyword)')
codeExamples.explanation: Timestamps: Segment-level (automatic) + word-level (word_timestamps=True). SRT subtitle export. 20ms resolution. Video captioning, search.

codeExamples.title: Hallucination Detection & Mitigation
codeExamples.code:
import whisper
import numpy as np

model = whisper.load_model('base')

def detect_hallucination(result, threshold=-1.0):
    """
    Detect potential hallucination based on:
    1. Low average log probability
    2. High no_speech probability
    3. Repetitive text
    """
    issues = []
    
    # Check confidence
    if hasattr(result, 'avg_logprob') and result.avg_logprob < threshold:
        issues.append(f'Low confidence (logprob: {result.avg_logprob:.2f})')
    
    # Check silence
    if hasattr(result, 'no_speech_prob') and result.no_speech_prob > 0.7:
        issues.append(f'Likely silence (no_speech: {result.no_speech_prob:.2f})')
    
    # Check repetition
    text = result.text if hasattr(result, 'text') else str(result)
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) > 10:
        unique_ratio = len(set(words)) / len(words)
        if unique_ratio < 0.3:
            issues.append(f'Repetitive text (unique ratio: {unique_ratio:.2f})')
    
    return issues

# Test with silence (hallucination risk)
print('=== Test 1: Clean Speech ===')
audio_clean = whisper.load_audio('clean_speech.mp3')
mel_clean = whisper.log_mel_spectrogram(whisper.pad_or_trim(audio_clean)).to(model.device)
options = whisper.DecodingOptions(language='en')
result_clean = whisper.decode(model, mel_clean, options)

print(f'Text: {result_clean.text}')
print(f'Confidence: {result_clean.avg_logprob:.2f}')
print(f'No speech prob: {result_clean.no_speech_prob:.3f}')
issues = detect_hallucination(result_clean)
print(f'Issues: {issues if issues else "None"}\n')

# Test with silence
print('=== Test 2: Silence (Hallucination Risk) ===')
audio_silence = np.zeros(16000 * 30)  # 30 seconds silence
mel_silence = whisper.log_mel_spectrogram(whisper.pad_or_trim(audio_silence)).to(model.device)
result_silence = whisper.decode(model, mel_silence, options)

print(f'Text: {result_silence.text}')
print(f'Confidence: {result_silence.avg_logprob:.2f}')
print(f'No speech prob: {result_silence.no_speech_prob:.3f}')
issues = detect_hallucination(result_silence, threshold=-1.0)
print(f'Issues: {issues if issues else "None"}')

print('\n=== Mitigation Strategies ===')
print('1. VAD (Voice Activity Detection) preprocessing')
print('2. Logprob threshold (filter low-confidence)')
print('3. No speech probability check (> 0.7 → skip)')
print('4. Repetition detection (unique_words / total_words)')
print('5. Prompt: "No speech" or "Silence" for decoder')
print('6. Temperature sampling (fallback, increase diversity)')
codeExamples.explanation: Hallucination: Silence → random/repetitive text. Detection: Low logprob, high no_speech_prob, repetition. Mitigation: VAD, thresholds, prompt.

options: Silence/noise → random/repetitive text. Önleme: VAD, logprob threshold, no_speech_prob check
quiz.explanation: Hallucination: Silence → model random/repetitive text üretir. Mitigation: VAD (silence detection), logprob threshold, no_speech_prob > 0.7 → skip.

quiz.question: Whisper model sizes ve trade-off?
options: tiny (39M, 32x realtime) → large-v3 (1.55B, 1x realtime). Trade-off: Speed vs accuracy
quiz.explanation: Whisper models: tiny/base (fast, mobile) vs medium/large (accurate, slow). Trade-off: Speed (realtime factor) vs WER (accuracy).
